claims.claim: Added the current Human-approved PTE_INFORMATION_ONLY planning record while preserving TASK-415's single-NEXT binding, prior roadmap records and CAA-05 conditional state without inferring lifecycle outcomes.
The successor document defines bounded authenticated information projection and excludes PTE workflow, audit, retry, dispatch, correction-selection and semantic-verdict authority.
The successor explicitly preserves historical PTE-01..03 meanings, source authentication, privacy and compatibility, with no retrospective PASS or TASK/RUN mutation.
PTE-04 is specified as conditional authenticated read-only worktree observation, with UNKNOWN/unavailable outcomes and explicit exclusion of snapshot, storage and worktree mutation.
PTE-05/06 recovery dependencies are prospectively retired from PTE; future dirty recovery requires separate Human/Brain selection, authority and TASK.
PTE-07's mandatory TASK-401 r3 chain is replaced by bounded information-only conformance criteria independent of PTE-controlled workflow and CAA.
The documents preserve TASK-408 direct authoring, exact Human-on-demand TCA/ROA/MOA and soft AOA opt-out without fallback or legacy-default reactivation.
The old PTE roadmap has a conspicuous prospective-supersession banner and successor pointer; its original identity and historical narrative remain intact.
Projected next_action/authority are explicitly contextualized as Runtime observations; missing, stale, forged, private and unavailable sources remain marked rather than promoted to truth.
The successor explicitly separates PTE, CAA and lifecycle authorities and states that unavailable or opted-out CAA cannot block observational readers.

Only the four permitted planning/documentation files changed. Production and verification sources remain untouched, existing Brain Sync verification targets are retained, and no full-suite or benchmark requirement was introduced.
